name: jira-field-visibility

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:firefox
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run build:firefox && npm run e2e:chrome && npm run e2e:firefox

description: A Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that lets you hide or show Jira Cloud issue fields, per issue type. Preferences are stored only in your browser via `chrome.storage.sync` — there is no backend, no account, and no data leaves your machine (`chrome.storage.sync` syncs across your own signed-in Chrome profiles only).
